data.r_code: Xs <- apply_woe(make_bins(dat)); pd <- as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata = Xs, type = 'response')); points <- round(600 + (50 / log(2)) * log((1 - pd) / pd)); decision <- ifelse(pd > 0.35, 'DECLINE', 'APPROVE'); mrf_export(frame = dat, score = pd, decision = decision, coef = coef(fit), train_rows = seq_len(nrow(dat)))
data.explanation: I used the entire dataset 'dat' as the frame to ensure all rows are scored. The score was calculated using the fitted model 'fit' on the transformed data 'Xs', which corresponds to the raw inputs. The training rows were specified as all rows in 'dat' since the model was fitted on the complete dataset.
